messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed deploy-bot auto-bumped a patch for a docs-only PR (chore/docs). Is that still the policy?
aj: I thought we skip for docs-only unless there's any code change.
sylvia: We used to skip, but releasebot rules changed last quarter to be conservative.
deploy-bot: releasebot detected changed files: docs/*, README.md -> applied patch bump 1.12.3 -> 1.12.4 :robot_face: (reason: changed files matched bump rule 'docs: include')
maria: That reason is noisy. For orgs that pin versions, extra patch bumps create noise and backfill churn.
tom: +1. It inflates the patch ledger and triggers deploy windows. Would prefer docs-only to be annotated with `[skip-release]` or similar.
priya: There are edgecases: if docs include config samples that tweak defaults, that can be a breaking user-visible change. Hard for bots to infer.
aj: Could we require an explicit commit tag like `[release=patch]` to force bump, and default to skip when only docs match? Simple heuristic: if only docs/* changed and commits contain `chore(docs)` -> skip.
sylvia: Sounds good but we also want a safeguard: a checkbox in PR template reminding authors to pick release impact.
release-admin-bot: Proposal link: https://go/releasebot/rfc-docs-bump-heuristic (please review).
maria: What about backcompat pinning? If a customer pins 1.12.3 and we push 1.12.4 for docs, that can lead to surprises in deploy dashboards. We should avoid non-functional bumps during quiet windows.
aj: Implementation idea: deploy-bot respects `release-impact` label with values `none|patch|minor`. If missing and only docs changed -> default `none`. If PR body contains explicit directive e.g. `Release: patch` -> obey it.
priya: Also add check in release pipeline: if semantic-diff detects no code/API change, auto-skip changelog generation and skip deploy window; still publish metadata with `skip=true`.
tom: Edge-case: generated files (e.g., docs generated from proto changes) live in docs/ but are actually code-impacting. We need to detect generated artifacts. Maybe rely on `changed_files` + `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD` heuristics plus a whitelist of generators.
sylvia: I'd rather a small gate: if deploy-bot is uncertain, mark `needs-release-review` instead of auto-bumping. Then a human can decide. 
maria: Agree. Prefer human-in-loop for unsure cases. 
aj: Ok I'll draft a tiny change for deploy-bot: default skip for docs-only, require explicit `Release:` directive to force bump, otherwise use `needs-release-review` if heuristics detect generated files. Patch attached in PR #4123.
release-admin-bot: Deploy window note: changing default could delay some automated fixes; ops please review for SLA impact.
ops (not present): :eyes: will comment in RFC.
maria: Thanks — if aj posts the PR link I can review today. If we land, let's hold the change until next Tuesday patch window. :calendar:
